description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference for various hidden layer configurations and activation functions across two models, mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis lists four distinct configurations: hidden:[50], linear; hidden:[], linear; hidden:[100], ReLU; and hidden:[50, 50], ReLU, representing different hidden layer setups and activation functions. The vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" and ranges from -0.2 to 0.2 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. For each configuration, two bars are presented side by side, with light blue representing mBERT and dark blue representing XLM-R. The bars for hidden:[50], linear are both negative, with mBERT at approximately -0.2 and XLM-R at around -0.05; for hidden:[], linear, mBERT is at about 0.08 and XLM-R is at roughly 0.21; for hidden:[100], ReLU, mBERT is at approximately -0.07 and XLM-R is at around 0.03; and for hidden:[50, 50], ReLU, both mBERT and XLM-R are negative, at around -0.17 and -0.14, respectively. The bars are grouped by configuration, with no specific sorting order observed, and no bars are visually emphasized.
